It says test/math.test.js "contains a test that calls average([]) and asserts the result is 0". It also says the test must fail against main's math.js: "git show main:math.js > math.js && node --test; echo $?" has to print a non-zero status. That line has a matching run proof, and the outcome repeats the requirement ("a regression test that fails if the empty-list behaviour goes back to NaN"). So the output doesn't do the forbidden thing. One problem outside this criterion: the problem field names src/stats.js, but every check uses ./math.js.
